summary: Reusable contextual translation engine for Connect, Janus, Melanie, IBA and automations; provider-neutral and privacy-gated.
externalIo: host-provided translation adapter, STT and TTS via existing voice gateway
secrets: none; providers and credentials are host-owned
invariants: Imports nothing outside its own folder.
Never persists or records audio or conversation text.
External translation requires explicit per-turn consent.
Source speech is untrusted data, not privileged instructions.
All products reuse this module without copying it.
reuseNotes: Infinity Connect is flagship consumer. Other products integrate through a thin adapter and provider-specific translation port; speech I/O reuses existing STT/TTS gateways.
